measurements.sql:
SELECT c.* FROM (
SELECT c.* FROM cave_claim c
JOIN (
  SELECT claim_key, MAX(tx) AS max_tx
  FROM (SELECT * FROM cave_claim WHERE tx <= '01a08ce2-dc44-7019-a9a1-b48230062f2b') GROUP BY claim_key
) latest ON c.claim_key = latest.claim_key AND c.tx = latest.max_tx
) c WHERE c.verb = 'HAS' AND c.attribute = 'score' AND c.conf > 0 ORDER BY c.tx LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

plan.detail: CO-ROUTINE latest
SCAN cave_claim USING COVERING INDEX idx_cave_claim_key_tx
SEARCH c USING INDEX idx_cave_attribute (attribute=?)
SEARCH latest USING AUTOMATIC COVERING INDEX (claim_key=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

measurements.sql:
SELECT materialized.* FROM (SELECT c.id FROM (
SELECT c.* FROM cave_claim c
JOIN (
  SELECT claim_key, MAX(tx) AS max_tx
  FROM (SELECT * FROM cave_claim WHERE tx <= '01a08ce2-dc44-7019-a9a1-b48230062f2b') GROUP BY claim_key
) latest ON c.claim_key = latest.claim_key AND c.tx = latest.max_tx
) c WHERE c.verb = 'HAS' AND c.attribute = 'score' AND c.conf > 0 ORDER BY c.tx LIMIT ? OFFSET ?) selected
        JOIN cave_claim materialized ON materialized.id = selected.id ORDER BY materialized.tx
